plugin.name: qBittorrent
plugin.description: View and manage torrents on a self-hosted qBittorrent instance.

tab.title: qBittorrent
tab.failed: Could not reach the Termix server.

view.title: View torrents
view.description: Open the qBittorrent tab and see the torrent list and transfer stats.

manage.title: Manage torrents
manage.description: Test the connection, add, start, stop and recheck torrents, and change categories and tags.

delete.title: Delete torrents
delete.description: Remove torrents, optionally together with their downloaded files.

baseUrl.label: qBittorrent URL
baseUrl.description: Address of the qBittorrent WebUI as reachable from the Termix server, for example http://qbittorrent:8080.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: Create one in the qBittorrent WebUI settings. Needs qBittorrent 5.2 or newer.
